# Podlink

> Podlink is podcast analytics, a link-in-bio page, and an AI content kit in
> one subscription. Download numbers come from OP3, the open, independently
> checkable measurement standard — numbers a sponsor can verify. Connect your
> RSS feed; no host migration, ever.

Podlink also runs done-for-you services: podcast editing, clips, sponsorship
sales, guest booking, advertising, and growth.

## Product

- [Home](https://podlink.ai/): what Podlink does, for podcasters and producers
- [Features](https://podlink.ai/features): download analytics, AI show notes,
  clips and social, transcripts, templates, newsletter, link-in-bio
- [Studio](https://podlink.ai/studio): for producers and agencies running
  multiple shows

## Connect an AI assistant

Podlink runs an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, so podcasters can connect
their show to Claude or other MCP clients and ask about their own analytics —
downloads, top listening apps, recent episodes — read-only, over OAuth, scoped
to their own account.

- [Podlink MCP](https://podlink.ai/features/mcp): what it does and how to
  connect
